name: enrollmentConfigurations
description: Device enrollment configurations such as device limits, platform restrictions, Windows Hello for Business and Enrollment Status Page settings

metadata.name: type
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const t = (typeof $['@odata.type'] === 'string' ? $['@odata.type'] : '').replace('#microsoft.graph.', ''); const names = { deviceEnrollmentLimitConfiguration: 'Device limit', deviceEnrollmentPlatformRestrictionsConfiguration: 'Platform restrictions', deviceEnrollmentPlatformRestrictionConfiguration: 'Platform restriction', deviceEnrollmentWindowsHelloForBusinessConfiguration: 'Windows Hello for Business', windows10EnrollmentCompletionPageConfiguration: 'Enrollment Status Page' }; return names[t] || t || null; })() }}

metadata.name: created
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const d = $['createdDateTime']; const t = d === null || d === undefined ? NaN : new Date(d).getTime(); return isNaN(t) || new Date(t).getUTCFullYear() <= 1901 ? null : d; })() }}
